description: Authenticates the subdomain a business sends its Albi emails from (for example news.theirbusiness.com): a return path, two DKIM keys and two link branding records at SendGrid. Applied with host set to that subdomain; nothing is added at the root of the domain.
variableDescription: Apply with host = the sending subdomain label (for example news). returnid: the number in SendGrid's return-path host (em<returnid>). sguser: the business's SendGrid account number. sgwl: SendGrid's white-label number. linkid: the number in SendGrid's link branding host (url<linkid>).
